root: ^In all my experience I have not seen something like this before...
^Meow. Hello, are those glasses? I didn’t know fish wore glasses.
^An ocean renowned researcher and scientist. And I need these glasses.
^I need this thing, it belongs to a girl above shore. I need to bring it back.
^But how will you get it up there?
^By my calculations, with your skinny frame and the object’s weight.
^you will never be able to carry it.
^...rude. I think you’re underestimating the stubbornness of a cat.
^Normally I work alone, as there is no one as smart as me.
^but alas I think I need your help.
^Oh, the “ocean renowned” scientist needs help from a shabby stray.
^Can’t you see? My ears are up. That means I’m listening.
^I have gathered research from the shore that will aid us in removing this unknown object.
^As I said earlier, you will never be able to carry it alone.
^Well, obviously. But I will have help.
^But if it were broken up into pieces that were more proportionate to your physical abilities.
^you could haul it back to shore piece by piece.
^Whaaaaat?! Break it up?! I can’t do that!
^There are four steps in total and each step will require you to find or craft a tool.
^Use tools?? But I don’t have opposable thumbs!
^You will use them to break up the guitar and thus carry it to the shore with ease.
^Destroying it is a crazy idea! I don’t need to do that, Eleni’s god will help me.
^She said her god will bring her guitar back.
^sigh* I don’t have time for this nonsense. If you want to take this guitar back to the dry, you need to do it yourself.
^I wanted to do something nice, but this is too much.
^Okay, fine. I know a basking shark that will destroy it.
^Either you follow my instructions or I will organise for the thing to be destroyed.
^Great! Now, this tablet will tell you the tools you’ll need to make.
^Go explore, talk to other fish and see what you can do. Otherwise this thing will be destroyed.
